Use case: stylized-concept. Create a production-ready pixel-art game BACKGROUND asset, wide 16:9, 1536x864 if possible. Input reference is the existing game's screenshot, for palette, style and scene layout only. Output ONLY the scenery, completely remove all UI, text, icons, border, scanlines, cards and HUD. Scene: the DRIFTERS world's forest road fork. Beautiful carefully composed 1990s dark-fantasy adventure pixel art. A winding pale dusty road enters at bottom center, divides at (50%,73%), leads to two convincing dark forest openings at (24%,48%) and (76%,48%). Asymmetric ancient oaks with winding roots frame the far left and far right edges; layered leafy boughs overhead; a few weathered rocks and fern clusters at the margins. Small crooked wooden direction marker around (50%,57%). Convincing spatial depth, clear foreground/midground/background, confident chunky pixel silhouettes. A quiet mysterious lived-in woodland, not a busy fantasy illustration.
Composition must support existing UI: top 18% low contrast and dark enough for HUD/title, lower-left x10-37% y46-81% and lower-right x63-90% y46-81% will be covered by dark choice panels, so major beauty/details in upper middle y20-45%, outer margins and bottom center. Keep both routes readable in visible space between panels. No baked-in panels.
Style: genuinely crisp low-resolution pixel art, designed as a 640x360 game scene displayed enlarged, every edge follows the same square pixel grid. Strong pixel clusters, hand-placed-looking broken contour highlights, restrained selective checkerboard dithering only in shadow transitions. Five warm neutral tones: near-black #0a0806, bark shadow #3a3128, stone brown #7d6d5a, warm tan #c9b79a, ivory #f5ecd9. Mostly darkest three tones; restrained light on the road. Match reference's sepia monochrome identity but improve its anatomy, depth and composition. Do not copy its repetitive circular tree blobs.
Avoid: painterly brushwork, smooth gradients, blur, antialiasing, 3D, cinematic glow, bloom, volumetric light beams, shiny plastic, overly intricate speckle noise, random sparkles, perfect symmetry, generic AI fantasy clutter, text or logos. Entire canvas scenery, no frame.
